compiled_state.description:
Register the new files in .test-index and ensure the executable bit is set on the implementation script.

Steps:
1. Run `chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh` immediately after creation
2. Add the following line to .test-index (maintaining alphabetical order within the scripts section):
   plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh:tests/scripts/test-migrate-story-pr-bases.sh
3. Verify no duplicate entries exist in .test-index via check-test-index-duplicates.sh
4. Verify tests/scripts/test-migrate-story-pr-bases.sh is executable (chmod +x)
5. Run the test file via the test-batched.sh runner to confirm all tests pass (GREEN state verified)
